variants.candidate: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. What you give, Earth settles into a shape that holds. As a friction, the gate never shuts, so you keep giving or keep proving instead of taking in. You run empty on comfort given and points already won.
variants.original: Earth is your Expression, and as a friction, it is making monuments out of moments: every idea formalized, every project turned permanent, output hardening while your energy thins.

variants.candidate: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Growing is what Wood makes of it. As a friction, intake outruns use and you take in more than you decide, your odd way or the way home taught you. You keep what you know where nobody learns it.
variants.original: Wood is your Mind, and as a friction, it is more fuel than one flame can use: courses, books, mentors, plans, all of it feeding a fire that burns hotter than it burns long.

variants.candidate: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Water keeps it deep, and rules sink in to stay. As a friction, the pull turns inward, so you hold your rank rather than risk it on a crisis and pay in tests never taken.
variants.original: Water is your Order, and as a friction, it is caution soaking through everything: every plan reviewed until the moment passes, every spark second-guessed into a maybe. The checking now costs more than the mistakes would, and the hardest judge of the flame is you.

variants.candidate: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Fire keeps it bright and quick. Running over, it spills into contests, so you would sooner be right alone than level with a peer or double a stake than share it. You win most days and pay in company.
variants.original: Fire is your Body, and running over, it is more heat than your days can spend: sleep that will not come, intensity leaking into every conversation, rest that feels like a punishment.

variants.candidate: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Metal keeps it exact, and nothing you claim counts until it is finished. As a friction, you take on past your strength, and you start a new venture rather than keep the money and love already yours.
variants.original: Metal is your Action, and as a friction, it is reworking what should be finished: renegotiating settled things, polishing shipped work, effort spent softening what was already solid. Done is a decision you keep reopening.
